summary: Iteration 8 e2e testing of 6 new features: Trip Sheet edit auto-recalc invoice, Trip View page, supplier freight detailed calculation + supplier profit formula (Customer − (Supplier − Advance)), Supplier P&L report columns/totals, /reports/pl now includes supplier_net_payable, and 2-page LR PDF (details on page 1, T&C only on page 2). All 8 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend UI checks confirm View/Edit buttons on Trips list, TripView page renders all required sections with correct amounts, invoiced-edit-warning banner visible, TripForm supplier detailed fields present, and Supplier P&L table has all 10 required columns.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2034 lines — well above 700 line guideline; consider splitting into routers per resource (trips.py, invoices.py, reports.py) for maintainability.

_compute_trip supplier branch: when supplier_freight_mode='per_ton' with supplier_rate_per_ton==0, supplier_freight is preserved (good), but if user later switches mode via UI without clearing rate, edge cases may occur — currently correct because the else-if guards on >0.

GET /reports/pl uses trip.total_expense which already contains (supplier_freight − supplier_advance) for supplier trips; the 'supplier_net_payable' label in the response is slightly misleading — it equals (supplier_freight − supplier_advance), NOT (supplier_freight − supplier_advance − other_recoveries). Consider renaming to supplier_cost or documenting.
PUT /api/trips/{id} does not enforce delete_trip/edit_trip permission checks for staff users editing an invoiced trip — worth reviewing RBAC coverage on this newly enabled path.

Frontend Reports.jsx SupplierPLReport uses default date range = first-of-current-month to today; no way to see historical supplier profits by default. Consider defaulting to current FY or last 90 days.
seed_data_creation: All test data created via API with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up in test fixtures/finally blocks. UI test also created a customer + supplier trip + invoice, then deleted them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_features.py covers compute (per_ton/fixed/manual/own), invoice auto-recompute on edit, supplier-pl aggregation & totals, /reports/pl supplier_net_payable field, and LR PDF 2-page split validated with PyMuPDF (fitz). Frontend Reports has NESTED routes: use /reports/supplier-pl directly, /reports/pl, etc. — do not just click the tab and expect Run button (Ledger's Run button is only for Ledger). TripView renders currency as '₹ 20,000.00' with commas — search using raw substring '20,000' or numeric parse rather than '20000'.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issues. All 6 requested features verified end-to-end.
